introHtml: Desk mugs with handles offer the familiar comfort of a traditional coffee cup, making them a natural fit for daily office use. Unlike handled mugs that can feel bulky, these 11 oz mugs are sized for standard desk spaces and fit most cup holders. The metallic finish options add a professional sheen that stands out in break rooms and conference tables. Add your logo with full-color imprinting for a polished look that employees and clients will reach for every morning.
